currentRoundInspection.placement: The inspected exterior picture supports the pale cylindrical shelter, dark conical roof, raised doorway, plaque, cut1895 flag and metal anchors/guy ropes. The retained mapped circle supplies location and diameter. Heading0 places the model doorway approximately south; this is an explicit approximate facing choice, not a measured doorway bearing. Standard viewer PMTiles provide the summit working datum 2777.579296317931m. The small original shell/anchor contact plane uses modelY0; coarse summit slope and actual rock details are approximate.

limitations: Approximate facing and summit fit from the inspected picture and standard viewer PMTiles; no bespoke bearing or exact rock survey. The circular mapped outline fixes location and diameter but cannot establish entrance bearing.
